s0001.literal: Second year of Zhishun, spring, first month, on jimao day, the Emperor personally composed the 《Record of the Kui Zhang Pavilion》.
s0001.idiomatic: Second year of Zhishun, spring, first month, on jimao day, the Emperor personally composed the 《Record of the Kui Zhang Pavilion》.

s0002.literal: Mobile privy council officials said: "In the eleventh month, acting Rendeh Prefecture darughachi Qushu gathered troops to campaign against Yunnan; he first defeated the rebel troops of Boqu at Malong Prefecture; on the eleventh day of that month he killed Boqu's younger brother Bairan and presented heads to the Prince of Yu.
s0002.idiomatic: Mobile privy council officials said: "In the 11th month, acting Rendeh Prefecture darughachi Qushu gathered troops to campaign against Yunnan; he first defeated the rebel troops of Boqu at Malong Prefecture; on the 11th day of that month he killed Boqu's younger brother Bairan and presented heads to the Prince of Yu.

s0004.literal: They fought at Majin Mountain, captured Boqu and his younger brother Boyan Tsaghur and more than ten of his followers including Baibuhua and Boyan Temür, executed them; the remaining troops all fled; only Luchu still held the Jinsha River.
s0004.idiomatic: They fought at Majin Mountain, captured Boqu and his younger brother Boyan Tsaghur and more than 10 of his followers including Baibuhua and Boyan Temür, executed them; the remaining troops all fled; only Luchu still held the Jinsha River.

s0005.literal: " An edict ordered urgent advance of troops to suppress him.
s0005.idiomatic: " An edict ordered urgent advance of troops to suppress him.

s0006.literal: On gengchen day, Baofeng, abbot of the Great Cheng Tian Protecting the Sagely Monastery, was promoted to Grand Mentor.
s0006.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Baofeng, abbot of the Great Cheng Tian Protecting the Sagely Monastery, was promoted to Grand Mentor.

s0007.literal: On xinsi day, Cao Ge of Wei County in Daming Prefecture contributed grain to relieve famine in Shaanxi; his household gate was honored.
s0007.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Cao Ge of Wei County in Daming Prefecture contributed grain to relieve famine in Shaanxi; his household gate was honored.

s0008.literal: On guiwei day, the Directorate of Palace Attendance was established to oversee inner attendants, rank 2b.
s0008.idiomatic: On guiwei day, the Directorate of Palace Attendance was established to oversee inner attendants, rank 2b.

s0009.literal: On yiyou day, the seasonal offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0009.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the seasonal offering was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0010.literal: On bingxu day, Bayan, Yolu Temür, Yolu Buhua, Abu Haiya, and fourteen others were all made to concurrently hold palace attendance posts with their existing offices.
s0010.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Bayan, Yolu Temür, Yolu Buhua, Abu Haiya, and 14 others were all made to concurrently hold palace attendance posts with their existing offices.

s0011.literal: Li, wife of Guo Zhong'an of Daxing County in Dadu, was honored for chastity.
s0011.idiomatic: Li, wife of Guo Zhong'an of Daxing County in Dadu, was honored for chastity.

s0012.literal: On dinghai day, because the monastery Yingzong had built on Shou'an Mountain was unfinished, the central secretariat was ordered to supply one hundred thousand ingots of notes for its expenses, and Yan Temür, Sadi, and others were still ordered to oversee the labor.
s0012.idiomatic: On dinghai day, because the monastery Yingzong had built on Shou'an Mountain was unfinished, the central secretariat was ordered to supply 100,000 ingots of notes for its expenses, and Yan Temür, Sadi, and others were still ordered to oversee the labor.

s0013.literal: Rear Guard commander Shi Kan was ordered to go to the Sichuan Branch Secretariat to select military officers.
s0013.idiomatic: Rear Guard commander Shi Kan was ordered to go to the Sichuan Branch Secretariat to select military officers.

s0014.literal: On wuzi day, Nuduchi Aliqa was ordered to inspect grazing lands along the northern frontier.
s0014.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Nuduchi Aliqa was ordered to inspect grazing lands along the northern frontier.

s0015.literal: More than twenty-four thousand households including Liu Yuanliang among the Jin estate's subject people were made perpetual-tenure households subordinate to the Shou'an Mountain Great Zhaoxiao Monastery.
s0015.idiomatic: More than 24,000 households including Liu Yuanliang among the Jin estate's subject people were made perpetual-tenure households subordinate to the Shou'an Mountain Great Zhaoxiao Monastery.

s0016.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Sichuan provincial officials Toghan and Toqtemür and others campaigned against Yunnan; on the ninth day of the eleventh month they led troops to Wusa Zhouni Post Station.
s0016.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said: "Sichuan provincial officials Toghan and Toqtemür and others campaigned against Yunnan; on the 9th day of the 11th month they led troops to Wusa Zhouni Post Station.

s0017.literal: The next day, more than ten thousand rebel troops under Luchu, Anu, and Ada emerged by a hidden mountain path from behind the range.
s0017.idiomatic: The next day, more than 10,000 rebel troops under Luchu, Anu, and Ada emerged by a hidden mountain path from behind the range.

s0018.literal: Toghan, Toqtemür, and others advanced to attack and repeatedly defeated them.
s0018.idiomatic: Toghan, Toqtemür, and others advanced to attack and repeatedly defeated them.

s0019.literal: On the fifteenth day they fought again at Qixing Pass; in six days there were seventeen battles in all; the rebels were greatly defeated and fled.
s0019.idiomatic: On the 15th day they fought again at Qixing Pass; in 6 days there were 17 battles in all; the rebels were greatly defeated and fled.

s0020.literal: " An edict dispatched envoys bearing silver and silks to reward Toghan, Toqtemür, and the others.
s0020.idiomatic: " An edict dispatched envoys bearing silver and silks to reward Toghan, Toqtemür, and the others.

s0021.literal: The year's quota of note reserves was minted: eight hundred ninety thousand fifty ingots of Zhiyuan notes and five thousand ingots of Zhongtong notes.
s0021.idiomatic: The year's quota of note reserves was minted: 890,050 ingots of Zhiyuan notes and 5,000 ingots of Zhongtong notes.

s0022.literal: Five thousand ingots of notes were granted to relieve the famished people of Ninghai Prefecture.
s0022.idiomatic: 5,000 ingots of notes were granted to relieve the famished people of Ninghai Prefecture.

s0023.literal: The Yidu and elsewhere Broad Agriculture Intendancy was abolished and replaced with the Land-Tax Directorate-General, rank 3b, still placed under the Longxiang Directorate-General.
s0023.idiomatic: The Yidu and elsewhere Broad Agriculture Intendancy was abolished and replaced with the Land-Tax Directorate-General, rank 3b, still placed under the Longxiang Directorate-General.

s0024.literal: Xinghe Route was ordered to build Yan Temür's hawking mews.
s0024.idiomatic: Xinghe Route was ordered to build Yan Temür's hawking mews.

s0025.literal: Privy council officials said: "The Sichuan Branch Secretariat borders Wusa, yet Yunnan is not yet pacified; garrison troops are few and thin; troops should be increased for defense.
s0025.idiomatic: Privy council officials said: "The Sichuan Branch Secretariat borders Wusa, yet Yunnan is not yet pacified; garrison troops are few and thin; troops should be increased for defense.

s0026.literal: We request transferring seven hundred qielian household service men from Kuizhou Route and three hundred soldiers of the two battalions of Chongqing Hedong's five circuits to garrison there together.
s0026.idiomatic: We request transferring 700 qielian household service men from Kuizhou Route and 300 soldiers of the 2 battalions of Chongqing Hedong's 5 circuits to garrison there together.

s0027.literal: When the campaign troops return, all shall be dismissed and sent home.
s0027.idiomatic: When the campaign troops return, all shall be dismissed and sent home.

s0029.literal: On gengyin day, the Eastern Route Mongol Army Wanhu Office was renamed the Eastern Route Mongol Palace Guard Command.
s0029.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Eastern Route Mongol Army Wanhu Office was renamed the Eastern Route Mongol Palace Guard Command.

s0030.literal: Prince Kharmang dispatched envoys to present grape wine as tribute.
s0030.idiomatic: Prince Kharmang dispatched envoys to present grape wine as tribute.

s0031.literal: By national regulation, successive reigns' traveling encampments had guards and attendants as when the sovereign was on the throne.
s0031.idiomatic: By national regulation, successive reigns' traveling encampments had guards and attendants as when the sovereign was on the throne.

s0032.literal: Recently the redundant and excessive were cut; for the Wuzong and Renzong reigns each was fixed at eight hundred men, and for Yingzong seven hundred men.
s0032.idiomatic: Recently the redundant and excessive were cut; for the Wuzong and Renzong reigns each was fixed at 800 men, and for Yingzong 700 men.

s0033.literal: Central secretariat officials said that among the former attendants some had lost their posts; an edict restored one hundred of them.
s0033.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said that among the former attendants some had lost their posts; an edict restored 100 of them.

s0034.literal: On xinmao day, Crown Prince Alaqa Nadala died.
s0034.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Crown Prince Alaqa Nadala died.

s0035.literal: On renchen day, fifty-eight persons including palace steward Fali and attendants were ordered to escort the spirit carriage north for joint burial at the imperial tombs, and Fali and the others were still ordered to guard it.
s0035.idiomatic: On renchen day, 58 persons including palace steward Fali and attendants were ordered to escort the spirit carriage north for joint burial at the imperial tombs, and Fali and the others were still ordered to guard it.

s0036.literal: Surveillance censors memorialized: "Fujian Branch Secretariat associate commissioner Haji, formerly Guangdong surveillance vice commissioner, was greedy and corrupt beyond reckoning — he should be dismissed.
s0036.idiomatic: Surveillance censors memorialized: "Fujian Branch Secretariat associate commissioner Haji, formerly Guangdong surveillance vice commissioner, was greedy and corrupt beyond reckoning — he should be dismissed.

s0038.literal: On jihai day, Minister of Personnel Sarva, wearing a tiger tally, and Ministry of Rites bureau director Zhao Qiyi, wearing a gold tally, were dispatched bearing the accession proclamation to announce to Annan, and also granted the 《Season-Granting Calendar》.
s0038.idiomatic: On jihai day, Minister of Personnel Sarva, wearing a tiger tally, and Ministry of Rites bureau director Zhao Qiyi, wearing a gold tally, were dispatched bearing the accession proclamation to announce to Annan, and also granted the 《Season-Granting Calendar》.

s0039.literal: Prince of Wu Ning Cheche Tu was granted one hundred taels of gold and five hundred taels of silver, and Haining Prefecture in Huai'an Route was made his fief.
s0039.idiomatic: Prince of Wu Ning Cheche Tu was granted 100 taels of gold and 500 taels of silver, and Haining Prefecture in Huai'an Route was made his fief.

s0040.literal: On guimao day, because the rash illness of Prince Guna Nadala had healed, Yan Temür and Princess Chaghijir were each granted one hundred taels of gold, five hundred taels of silver, and two thousand ingots of notes; Sadun and others received gold, silver, and notes in varying amounts;
s0040.idiomatic: On guimao day, because the rash illness of Prince Guna Nadala had healed, Yan Temür and Princess Chaghijir were each granted 100 taels of gold, 500 taels of silver, and 2,000 ingots of notes; Sadun and others received gold, silver, and notes in varying amounts;

s0041.literal: physicians, shamans, wet nurses, eunuchs, and guards — six hundred persons in all — were also granted three hundred fifty taels of gold, three thousand four hundred taels of silver, and five thousand three hundred forty ingots of notes.
s0041.idiomatic: physicians, shamans, wet nurses, eunuchs, and guards — 600 persons in all — were also granted 350 taels of gold, 3,400 taels of silver, and 5,340 ingots of notes.

s0042.literal: On jiachen day, an edict ordered the four annual sacrifices to the Great Taiyi Star of the Five Blessings.
s0042.idiomatic: On jiachen day, an edict ordered the 4 annual sacrifices to the Great Taiyi Star of the Five Blessings.

s0043.literal: A Confucius temple was built at the Rear Guard.
s0043.idiomatic: A Confucius temple was built at the Rear Guard.

s0044.literal: At the end of the Zhiyuan era, campaigning against Prince Nayan's rebellion, Mongol troops of his following were captured and distributed among Henan, Jiang-Zhe, Huguang, and Jiangxi provinces; the privy council was ordered to dispatch envoys to register their numbers and found two thousand six hundred men.
s0044.idiomatic: At the end of the Zhiyuan era, campaigning against Prince Nayan's rebellion, Mongol troops of his following were captured and distributed among Henan, Jiang-Zhe, Huguang, and Jiangxi provinces; the privy council was ordered to dispatch envoys to register their numbers and found 2,600 men.

s0045.literal: On yisi day, the spirit worshipped by Mongol shamans was enfeoffed as King Linggan Zhaoying Huguo Zhongshun, and its temple was titled Lingyou.
s0045.idiomatic: On yisi day, the spirit worshipped by Mongol shamans was enfeoffed as King Linggan Zhaoying Huguo Zhongshun, and its temple was titled Lingyou.

s0046.literal: The guards' annual allotment of notes was granted — eighty ingots per man, one-fifth of which was taken in other goods and grain.
s0046.idiomatic: The guards' annual allotment of notes was granted — 80 ingots per man, one-fifth of which was taken in other goods and grain.

s0047.literal: Western Pacification Martial Tranquility King Chaghan Temür, Prince of Yu Alaqa Nasirli, and branch secretariat and branch privy council officials jointly campaigned against Yunnan with more than one hundred thousand troops; on the eleventh day of the eleventh month last year Chaghan Temür's army halted at Luoluo; they expected Yolqi Temür to arrive together at Sanbolang, and still urged Xiao Yunshi to meet at Qujing, Malong, and other prefectures to advance together.
s0047.idiomatic: Western Pacification Martial Tranquility King Chaghan Temür, Prince of Yu Alaqa Nasirli, and branch secretariat and branch privy council officials jointly campaigned against Yunnan with more than 100,000 troops; on the 11th day of the 11th month last year Chaghan Temür's army halted at Luoluo; they expected Yolqi Temür to arrive together at Sanbolang, and still urged Xiao Yunshi to meet at Qujing, Malong, and other prefectures to advance together.

s0048.literal: Yolqi Temür pressed forward by forced marches and seized the Jinsha River.
s0048.idiomatic: Yolqi Temür pressed forward by forced marches and seized the Jinsha River.

s0049.literal: On the seventeenth day of the twelfth month the main army encountered Ahe's Mongol troops, defeated them, and Ahe feigned surrender; the next day he led three thousand of his troops in three columns to raid Our camp; Chaghan Temür, Yolqi Temür, and others divided into thirteen columns and again defeated them; Ahe fled in disorder; the main army pressed straight for Zhongqing.
s0049.idiomatic: On the 17th day of the 12th month the main army encountered Ahe's Mongol troops, defeated them, and Ahe feigned surrender; the next day he led 3,000 of his troops in 3 columns to raid Our camp; Chaghan Temür, Yolqi Temür, and others divided into 13 columns and again defeated them; Ahe fled in disorder; the main army pressed straight for Zhongqing.

s0050.literal: On the twenty-sixth day they met rebel Mongol troops at Anning Prefecture and fought again, again defeating them greatly.
s0050.idiomatic: On the 26th day they met rebel Mongol troops at Anning Prefecture and fought again, again defeating them greatly.

s0051.literal: On the twenty-eighth day Ahe came to give battle and was thereupon captured and beheaded before the army.
s0051.idiomatic: On the 28th day Ahe came to give battle and was thereupon captured and beheaded before the army.

s0052.literal: On the thirtieth day, as they were about to reach Zhongqing, seven thousand rebel troops still resisted at Qiqiao and Gubikou; when the armies clashed, Yolqi Temür was struck by an arrow in the left cheek that pierced behind the ear; he pulled out the arrow and fought again; there was a great victory, and the branch secretariat administration was restored.
s0052.idiomatic: On the 30th day, as they were about to reach Zhongqing, 7,000 rebel troops still resisted at Qiqiao and Gubikou; when the armies clashed, Yolqi Temür was struck by an arrow in the left cheek that pierced behind the ear; he pulled out the arrow and fought again; there was a great victory, and the branch secretariat administration was restored.

s0053.literal: All armies assembled and encamped within the city; troops were divided to pursue remnant rebels at Songming Prefecture.
s0053.idiomatic: All armies assembled and encamped within the city; troops were divided to pursue remnant rebels at Songming Prefecture.

s0054.literal: Privy council officials reported the victory; an edict ordered the overall commanders to gauge urgency and ease and dispose as circumstances required.
s0054.idiomatic: Privy council officials reported the victory; an edict ordered the overall commanders to gauge urgency and ease and dispose as circumstances required.

s0055.literal: The chief of Wenghe Stockade in the Xintian Pacification Commission complained that other departments' corvée laborers and Liao people trampled his grain and the people were famished; Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to issue two thousand ingots of notes to buy rice for relief.
s0055.idiomatic: The chief of Wenghe Stockade in the Xintian Pacification Commission complained that other departments' corvée laborers and Liao people trampled his grain and the people were famished; Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to issue 2,000 ingots of notes to buy rice for relief.

s0056.literal: Second month, on bingxu day, Shangdu garrison commander Naimatai was made administrator of the Northern Pacification Mobile Privy Council; Taixi Zongyin commissioner Jinjir, Dalindari, and Doliniq were all made privy council administrators by remote appointment as associate grand councillors.
s0056.idiomatic: Second month, on bingxu day, Shangdu garrison commander Naimatai was made administrator of the Northern Pacification Mobile Privy Council; Taixi Zongyin commissioner Jinjir, Dalindari, and Doliniq were all made privy council administrators by remote appointment as associate grand councillors.

s0057.literal: On wushen day, the Broad Teaching Directorate-General was established to govern Buddhist and Daoist clergy; there were sixteen jurisdictions in all: the Capital Region and Shanhou Circuit; Hedong and Shanxi Circuit; Liaodong and Shanbei Circuit; Henan and Jingbei Circuit; Liang-Huai and Jiangbei Circuit; Hubei and Hunan Circuit; Zhexi and Jiangdong Circuit; Zhedong and Fujian Circuit; Jiangxi and Guangdong Circuit; Guangxi and Lianghai Circuit; the various routes of Yan South; the various routes of Shandong; the various routes of Shaanxi; the various routes of Gansu; the various routes of Sichuan; and the various routes of Yunnan.
s0057.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Broad Teaching Directorate-General was established to govern Buddhist and Daoist clergy; there were 16 jurisdictions in all: the Capital Region and Shanhou Circuit; Hedong and Shanxi Circuit; Liaodong and Shanbei Circuit; Henan and Jingbei Circuit; Liang-Huai and Jiangbei Circuit; Hubei and Hunan Circuit; Zhexi and Jiangdong Circuit; Zhedong and Fujian Circuit; Jiangxi and Guangdong Circuit; Guangxi and Lianghai Circuit; the various routes of Yan South; the various routes of Shandong; the various routes of Shaanxi; the various routes of Gansu; the various routes of Sichuan; and the various routes of Yunnan.

s0058.literal: Rank 3a; the directorate-general had one darughachi, director-general, associate prefect, and judge each; the Commission for Buddhist and Secular Affairs selected inner-circuit officials for nomination and report; the director-general was a monk.
s0058.idiomatic: Rank 3a; the directorate-general had 1 darughachi, director-general, associate prefect, and judge each; the Commission for Buddhist and Secular Affairs selected inner-circuit officials for nomination and report; the director-general was a monk.

s0059.literal: The Sichuan Branch Secretariat induced the submission of the four caves of Ligu Shiyong and elsewhere in Huaide Prefecture and twelve caves of raw barbarians; all came within the allegiance; an edict promoted Huaide Prefecture to a Pacification Commission to garrison them.
s0059.idiomatic: The Sichuan Branch Secretariat induced the submission of the 4 caves of Ligu Shiyong and elsewhere in Huaide Prefecture and 12 caves of raw barbarians; all came within the allegiance; an edict promoted Huaide Prefecture to a Pacification Commission to garrison them.

s0060.literal: Each cave was given a native-official prefecture and patrol office, and they were also ordered each to return persons they had seized.
s0060.idiomatic: Each cave was given a native-official prefecture and patrol office, and they were also ordered each to return persons they had seized.

s0061.literal: Huguang associate administrator Cheku Temür, Susu, and Bandan were all punished for uttering complaints; interrogation established the facts; the Ministry of Justice judged that Cheku Temür and Bandan should receive one hundred seven blows of the staff and Susu should be executed; an amnesty intervened — Cheku Temür was exiled to Guangdong, Bandan to Guangxi, and Susu to Hainan — all placed in remote frontier prefectures.
s0061.idiomatic: Huguang associate administrator Cheku Temür, Susu, and Bandan were all punished for uttering complaints; interrogation established the facts; the Ministry of Justice judged that Cheku Temür and Bandan should receive 107 blows of the staff and Susu should be executed; an amnesty intervened — Cheku Temür was exiled to Guangdong, Bandan to Guangxi, and Susu to Hainan — all placed in remote frontier prefectures.

s0062.literal: An edict said: "These men harbored resentment toward Us; had it not been for the amnesty, all should have been put to the extreme penalty; their households may all be registered and confiscated; Susu is to be imprisoned for life.
s0062.idiomatic: An edict said: "These men harbored resentment toward Us; had it not been for the amnesty, all should have been put to the extreme penalty; their households may all be registered and confiscated; Susu is to be imprisoned for life.

s0063.literal: " On jiyou day, a white rainbow crossed the sun.
s0063.idiomatic: " On jiyou day, a white rainbow crossed the sun.

s0064.literal: Zhang, wife of Du Zulong of Jin Prefecture in Gongchang, was honored for steadfast integrity.
s0064.idiomatic: Zhang, wife of Du Zulong of Jin Prefecture in Gongchang, was honored for steadfast integrity.

s0065.literal: Privy council officials said: "Cheku Temür and Boluo on the first month, wuyin day, defeated Wusa barbarian troops, shot Luchu, and reduced his people; Wumeng, Dongchuan, Yiliang Prefecture barbarian troops, Yi, and Liao all came to submit.
s0065.idiomatic: Privy council officials said: "Cheku Temür and Boluo on the first month, wuyin day, defeated Wusa barbarian troops, shot Luchu, and reduced his people; Wumeng, Dongchuan, Yiliang Prefecture barbarian troops, Yi, and Liao all came to submit.

s0066.literal: Western Pacification Martial Tranquility King Chaghan Temür and others encamped at Zhongqing and restored branch secretariat affairs;
s0066.idiomatic: Western Pacification Martial Tranquility King Chaghan Temür and others encamped at Zhongqing and restored branch secretariat affairs;

s0067.literal: Prince of Yu Alaqa Nasirli and others reached Dangdang Post Station and pacified the people.
s0067.idiomatic: Prince of Yu Alaqa Nasirli and others reached Dangdang Post Station and pacified the people.

s0068.literal: " They also said: "Chengjiang Route native official Junrong reported that the rebels Gulahu and Buladu's younger brother Bila Dushmishi and others feigned surrender to the Prince of Yu yet turned to besiege him; reaching Yilong Post Station, Gulahu and others' troops ambushed the government army.
s0068.idiomatic: " They also said: "Chengjiang Route native official Junrong reported that the rebels Gulahu and Buladu's younger brother Bila Dushmishi and others feigned surrender to the Prince of Yu yet turned to besiege him; reaching Yilong Post Station, Gulahu and others' troops ambushed the government army.

s0069.literal: Sichuan Branch Secretariat associate grand councillor Toghan halted his army and did not advance; associate grand councillor Qizhu's wife, children, and livestock were seized by rebels.
s0069.idiomatic: Sichuan Branch Secretariat associate grand councillor Toghan halted his army and did not advance; associate grand councillor Qizhu's wife, children, and livestock were seized by rebels.

s0070.literal: Spies learned Buladu was repairing fortresses, deploying troops to resist and defend, with no intent to come out and surrender.
s0070.idiomatic: Spies learned Buladu was repairing fortresses, deploying troops to resist and defend, with no intent to come out and surrender.

s0071.literal: " An edict ordered rapid advance of troops to suppress them.
s0071.idiomatic: " An edict ordered rapid advance of troops to suppress them.

s0072.literal: An edict ordered tamachi scout soldiers to relocate each year on the tenth day of the fifth month to the various prefectures behind the mountains.
s0072.idiomatic: An edict ordered tamachi scout soldiers to relocate each year on the 10th day of the 5th month to the various prefectures behind the mountains.

s0073.literal: On xinhai day, Yan Temür's residence was built southwest of the Xingsheng Palace; an edict ordered Sadi and the garrison command to supervise the labor.
s0073.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Yan Temür's residence was built southwest of the Xingsheng Palace; an edict ordered Sadi and the garrison command to supervise the labor.

s0074.literal: On renzi day, Venus was seen in daylight.
s0074.idiomatic: On renzi day, Venus was seen in daylight.

s0075.literal: Central secretariat associate grand councillor Yireqi concurrently became pacification commissioner of Shenyang and other routes; Prince of Yan palace steward Barsari was made central secretariat associate grand councillor; Shaanxi Branch Secretariat associate censor Duorzhiban was made central secretariat associate administrator; Minister of Revenue Gao Lüheng and Liang-Huai salt transport commissioner Xu Youren were both made participants in central secretariat affairs.
s0075.idiomatic: Central secretariat associate grand councillor Yireqi concurrently became pacification commissioner of Shenyang and other routes; Prince of Yan palace steward Barsari was made central secretariat associate grand councillor; Shaanxi Branch Secretariat associate censor Duorzhiban was made central secretariat associate administrator; Minister of Revenue Gao Lüheng and Liang-Huai salt transport commissioner Xu Youren were both made participants in central secretariat affairs.

s0076.literal: On jiayin day, Yan Temür said: "Sayin Qalama'din, in Yingzong's time, once presented treasure goods to the Zhaoxian Yuansheng Empress Dowager; payment of one hundred twenty thousand ingots of notes was discussed; the former chancellor Baizhu memorialized compensation of seventy thousand ingots, which was not paid; in the Taiding era ten thousand six hundred sixty salt certificates were used to convert to notes and pay him; now the relevant office, by imperial writ, seizes them back for the government.
s0076.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Yan Temür said: "Sayin Qalama'din, in Yingzong's time, once presented treasure goods to the Zhaoxian Yuansheng Empress Dowager; payment of 120,000 ingots of notes was discussed; the former chancellor Baizhu memorialized compensation of 70,000 ingots, which was not paid; in the Taiding era 10,660 salt certificates were used to convert to notes and pay him; now the relevant office, by imperial writ, seizes them back for the government.

s0077.literal: We your subjects judge that since the Empress Dowager had already used the treasure goods, it is fitting to return them with salt certificates.
s0077.idiomatic: We your subjects judge that since the Empress Dowager had already used the treasure goods, it is fitting to return them with salt certificates.

s0079.literal: Yan Temür also said: "Anqing wanhu Suozhu, convicted of letting his household kill a man and imprisoned, has long failed to confess — if treated as without guilt, we beg his release.
s0079.idiomatic: Yan Temür also said: "Anqing wanhu Suozhu, convicted of letting his household kill a man and imprisoned, has long failed to confess — if treated as without guilt, we beg his release.

s0081.literal: On yimao day, Venus invaded the Pleiades.
s0081.idiomatic: On yimao day, Venus invaded the Pleiades.

s0082.literal: The imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong were sacrificed to.
s0082.idiomatic: The imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong were sacrificed to.

s0083.literal: Yunnan overall commanders came reporting victory; all barbarians had submitted, only Luchu's pursuit had not yet captured him.
s0083.idiomatic: Yunnan overall commanders came reporting victory; all barbarians had submitted, only Luchu's pursuit had not yet captured him.

s0084.literal: It was ordered that Han troops of each guard take rotating leave — two tenths were dismissed and sent home on the first day of the third month.
s0084.idiomatic: It was ordered that Han troops of each guard take rotating leave — 2 tenths were dismissed and sent home on the 1st day of the 3rd month.

s0085.literal: On dingsi day, imperial son-in-law Buyan Temür came to court from the northern frontier following Prince of Wu Ning Cheche Tu.
s0085.idiomatic: On dingsi day, imperial son-in-law Buyan Temür came to court from the northern frontier following Prince of Wu Ning Cheche Tu.

s0086.literal: On jiwei day, western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites for Prince Guna Nadala for one full year.
s0086.idiomatic: On jiwei day, western monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites for Prince Guna Nadala for 1 full year.

s0087.literal: On renxu day, Prince of Wu Ning Cheche Tu was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Tan and granted a gold seal.
s0087.idiomatic: On renxu day, Prince of Wu Ning Cheche Tu was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Tan and granted a gold seal.

s0088.literal: On jiazi day, central secretariat officials said: "The state's revenue in money and grain has fixed annual intake, yet expenditure is vast and complex, and therefore there is insufficiency.
s0088.idiomatic: On jiazi day, central secretariat officials said: "The state's revenue in money and grain has fixed annual intake, yet expenditure is vast and complex, and therefore there is insufficiency.

s0089.literal: In Tianli year 2, one-tenth of the salt tax was once converted to silver payment, gaining more than two thousand ingots of silver in all.
s0089.idiomatic: In Tianli year 2, one-tenth of the salt tax was once converted to silver payment, gaining more than 2,000 ingots of silver in all.

s0090.literal: We now request exchanging silver for government note reserves to supply the palace guard soldiers.
s0090.idiomatic: We now request exchanging silver for government note reserves to supply the palace guard soldiers.

s0091.literal: " They also said: "Your Majesty, without drawing on routine funds and without troubling the people, founded the Great Cheng Tian Protecting the Sagely Monastery.
s0091.idiomatic: " They also said: "Your Majesty, without drawing on routine funds and without troubling the people, founded the Great Cheng Tian Protecting the Sagely Monastery.

s0092.literal: We your subjects wish to offer up the note reserves previously exchanged — one hundred thousand ingots and six hundred ingots of silver — to assist the monastery's needs.
s0092.idiomatic: We your subjects wish to offer up the note reserves previously exchanged — 100,000 ingots and 600 ingots of silver — to assist the monastery's needs.

s0094.literal: On bingyin day, for those of the four great traveling encampments of Taizu who remained in the north and did not migrate, whose horses, camels, and livestock had largely died or been lost, ten thousand ingots of notes were issued and the Inner Secretariat was ordered to buy and supply them.
s0094.idiomatic: On bingyin day, for those of the 4 great traveling encampments of Taizu who remained in the north and did not migrate, whose horses, camels, and livestock had largely died or been lost, 10,000 ingots of notes were issued and the Inner Secretariat was ordered to buy and supply them.

s0095.literal: Mobile Privy Council administrator Aliqa came reporting Yunnan's victory.
s0095.idiomatic: Mobile Privy Council administrator Aliqa came reporting Yunnan's victory.

s0096.literal: On gengwu day, the guards' annual allotment of notes was granted; an edict ordered that it not exceed the fixed quota of ten thousand men.
s0096.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the guards' annual allotment of notes was granted; an edict ordered that it not exceed the fixed quota of 10,000 men.

s0097.literal: Champa dispatched its minister Gao Andula to come to court with tribute.
s0097.idiomatic: Champa dispatched its minister Gao Andula to come to court with tribute.

s0098.literal: The Five Blessings Great Taiyi Palace was founded in the northwest quarter of the capital; Hongxi and Chongshou halls at Shangdu were repaired.
s0098.idiomatic: The Five Blessings Great Taiyi Palace was founded in the northwest quarter of the capital; Hongxi and Chongshou halls at Shangdu were repaired.

s0099.literal: Princes Cheche Tu and Shage were convicted of reckless and improper speech; an edict ordered Cheche Tu settled at Guangzhou and Shage at Leizhou.
s0099.idiomatic: Princes Cheche Tu and Shage were convicted of reckless and improper speech; an edict ordered Cheche Tu settled at Guangzhou and Shage at Leizhou.

s0100.literal: On renshen day, Liaodong Branch Secretariat was ordered to issue grain to relieve the Mongol troops and people of King Dorji and Nahuadar and six other departments — fifteen thousand households in all.
s0100.idiomatic: On renshen day, Liaodong Branch Secretariat was ordered to issue grain to relieve the Mongol troops and people of King Dorji and Nahuadar and 6 other departments — 15,000 households in all.
